_doc: Base seed. OWNER: Person C. Keys match DB tables. Fixed ids so `npm run seed` is idempotent. Dates are RELATIVE (…DaysAgo, fractional ok) so the 30-day repeat window always holds. Story: SW-C4-01/port-13 has 6 resolved link_flap tickets in the last 30 days (replace_suggested) plus an in-progress live ticket `tkt-p13-active` (Alex) used for the handoff demo. Positions/parts are generated from seed/device-models.json.

tickets.title: Port 13 link flap on SW-C4-01 (#1)
tickets.description: acme-gpu uplink on port 13 dropped and re-established 3 times in 10 minutes.
tickets.resolutionNote: Cable seated loosely. Reseated at the switch end; link stable for 30 min.

tickets.title: Port 13 link flap on SW-C4-01 (#2)
tickets.description: Port 13 link flapping again, 5 flaps overnight.
tickets.resolutionNote: Reseated cable both ends. Link up, no flaps in 1h.

tickets.title: Port 13 link flap on SW-C4-01 (#3)
tickets.description: Port 13 flapping x7 in 5 minutes; tenant saw packet loss on training job.
tickets.resolutionNote: Cleaned the RJ45 contacts with isopropyl, reseated. Monitoring.

tickets.title: Port 13 link flap on SW-C4-01 (#4)
tickets.description: Port 13 down/up repeatedly after cleaning last week.
tickets.resolutionNote: Reseated again. Noticed slight kink near the connector; no spare cable on hand.

tickets.title: Port 13 link flap on SW-C4-01 (#5)
tickets.description: Port 13 flap storm, interface error counters climbing.
tickets.resolutionNote: Forced 1G and disabled EEE on the port as a stopgap. Held 24h.

tickets.title: Port 13 link flap on SW-C4-01 (#6)
tickets.description: Port 13 flapping for the sixth time this month.
tickets.resolutionNote: Reseated; link stable 45 min. Cable still suspect.

tickets.title: Port 13 dropping again on SW-C4-01 (replace cable?)
tickets.description: Port 13 on the C4 top switch is dropping again. Seventh flap ticket this month; reseating has not held.

tickets.title: PSU 2 fault on SRV-C1-01
tickets.description: BMC reports PSU 2 input lost intermittently; redundancy degraded.

tickets.title: Correctable ECC errors on DIMM A5 (SRV-C2-01)
tickets.description: EDAC reports rising correctable errors on dimm-A-5, 40+ in 24h.

tickets.title: CRC errors on SW-C6-01 port 31
tickets.description: Interface counters show growing CRC errors, no link drops yet.

tickets.title: Drive bay 4 predictive failure (SRV-C5-01)
tickets.description: SMART reports reallocated sector count rising on bay-4.

tickets.title: Drive bay 2 failed on SRV-C8-01
tickets.resolutionNote: Swapped failed drive for new HDD-77402; array rebuilding.
